# Sarnia Heating & Cooling

> Sarnia Heating & Cooling is an Ontario heating and cooling contractor based in Sarnia. Homeowners call the team for furnace and air conditioner repair, heat pump and ductless installation, fireplace service, smart thermostat setup, and full-system duct cleaning across Lambton County.

Phone: (226) 778-1469  |  Email: contact@sarniaheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://sarniaheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Sarnia, Point Edward, Corunna, Petrolia, Forest, Wyoming
